        if s: w(n, s)
    w("q.conf", "@include p.conf\n")
    for n in ["m.conf", "s.conf", "p.conf"]:
        try: load(os.path.join(d, n)); print("no error!")
        except ConfigError as e: print("ConfigError:", e)
EOF
